summary: Smaller settings icon font and guarded offline ContextLM preparation after signed v1.0.214. No new neural suggestions are enabled yet; Oppo acceptance remains pending.

changes.title: Compact settings font and safe ContextLM groundwork
changes.detail: Reduce the bundled variable settings/search icon font to its exact existing fixed visual style; mapped glyph outlines and names are preserved. Add a read-only adapter that passes current native suggestions and inherited user-history/user-dictionary signals as future neural model inputs, plus a bounded INT8 reference and fail-closed model-validation tests. The offline experimental model failed realistic prediction-quality gates: no model weights, runtime suggestion hook or changed predictions are shipped. Keep native learning, QuickType, swipe, voice, network policy, original package and signer unchanged. Real APK bytes, runtime stability and Oppo visuals require verification.
